description: This Java class serves as an adapter for RecyclerView in an Android application, specifically providing views to display usage statistics of apps, including package names, last time used, and app icons.

classes.name: UsageListAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for RecyclerView that manages the display of application usage statistics, including package name, last time used, and app icon.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class that holds references to views within a usage row layout, including package name TextView, last time used TextView, and app icon ImageView.

methods.name: UsageListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for UsageListAdapter; initializes the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the usage_row layout and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from CustomUsageStats to the views in the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the adapter.

methods.name: setCustomUsageStatsList
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomUsageStats objects to be displayed.
